paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Yasina. In Bekhorot 47b: R' Shimon Yasinya said. He said in R' Illa's name, who said in R' Berekhiah's name, in R' Helbo ב״י [unresolved B.Y.]'s name: Yelammedenu, beginning of Vayetze. There, Naso: ben Asina. In Rabbah, Naso, chapter 13: ben Yosanya. In R' Hoshaya's name: Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Ha-Ishah she-Halakh. R' Menahem, R' Elazar bar Avuna's son-in-law, reports in his name. R' Shimon the scribe asked him. He said in Resh Lakish's name: Kelal Gadol.
